==About==

A {{i|Radish}} is received by chance when picking up a recently killed {{i|Dead Rabbit}}, or, with the [[Vegetable Potting]] Skill learned, a Radish can be grown by planting another Radish in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. Planting Vegetables in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Radish can be stored in a {{i|Veggie Sack}}.
